      "rationale": "The condition that the area directory does not establish valve positions (n-lzsmwx) combined with no evidence of a recent change briefing or specific drawing usage (n-u3hp7x, n-1oeohee) creates an information gap. This gap allows for the hypothesis that an unrecorded service-routing change exists (n-se46ow), which could explain why pressure dropped locally while upstream remained stable.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": ["finding-5cvaiz", "claim-hpozhz"],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had seen a recent change briefing and used an updated drawing, they would likely have identified the valve state or recognized that their work was not authorized under current conditions.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop could be due to upstream supply issues unrelated to local valve states (n-6vnnqh).",
      "evidenceGap": "No record confirms whether a service-routing change occurred, nor does any evidence link the blank attachment field or lack of briefing directly to an undocumented valve state."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-1oeohee",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The condition that desk entries do not log every field operation (n-rga8k8) means the point of interruption is unknown. This lack of granularity prevents distinguishing between upstream, distribution system, or local equipment causes.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If desk entries logged every field operation, the specific point of interruption could be identified.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop may have been transient and unrelated to human error or procedural gaps (n-6vnnqh).",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence exists showing that a failure in logging operations directly caused the event; absence of logs does not prove an undocumented action occurred."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-1oeohee",
      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "The condition that the training extract does not state which configuration drawing was seen (n-u3hp7x) combined with no interview on fatigue or intent (n-zt9vpk) leaves open whether crew awareness of system changes affected their actions.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": ["eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the crew had received a recent change briefing, they might have recognized that their work was not authorized under current conditions.",
      "competingExplanation": "The pressure drop may have been caused by upstream supply issues unrelated to human factors (n-6vnnqh).",
      "evidenceGap": "No evidence links the lack of a recent change briefing directly to the event; absence of interview data does not prove fatigue or intent played a role."
    }
  ],
  "decision": {
    "summary": "The investigation identifies three primary causal branches: (1) potential unrecorded service-routing changes due to missing documentation and lack of recent change briefings, (2) gaps in field operation logging preventing identification of the interruption point, and (3) unknown crew awareness of system configurations. All remain hypotheses pending further evidence.",
    "evidenceUsed": ["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1", "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1", "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"],
    "unknowns": ["Whether a service-routing change occurred and was undocumented.", "The specific point of interruption in the distribution system.", "Crew awareness of recent changes or fatigue."],
    "alternatives": ["Upstream supply issue unrelated to local conditions (n-6vnnqh).", "Transient pressure fluctuation not linked to procedural gaps."],
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  "evidenceRequests": [
    "Request continuous waveform data for P-R and AL-44 between 10:00 AM and 10:07 AM to determine if the pressure drop was transient or sustained.",
    "Request engineering disposition records for any service-routing changes affecting RHOB instrument-air distribution during May 20, 2024."
  ]
}
